proposals.before: Thereupon Shi Qi was made magistrate of Ye, and he diverted Zhang River water to irrigate Ye, enriching Wei's Henan region.
proposals.after: Thereupon Shi Qi was made magistrate of Ye, and he diverted Zhang River water to irrigate Ye, enriching Wei's Henei region.
proposals.reason: Chinese 河內 is Henei, not Henan (河南); the literal line mistranslates the region name.

proposals.before: The emperor agreed, ordered the Qi water engineer Xu Bo to present a memorial, and mobilized tens of thousands. The canal was completed in three years.
proposals.after: The emperor agreed, ordered the Qi water engineer Xu Bo to survey and mark the route, and mobilized tens of thousands. The canal was completed in three years.
proposals.reason: In 令齊人水工徐伯表, 表 means to survey/stake out the canal line, not to present a memorial.

proposals.before: Du Qin advised General-in-chief Wang Feng: "At the previous breach, chancellor's clerk Yang Yan said Yanshi used Yan's method to block it and concealed refusing to see him.
proposals.after: Du Qin advised General-in-chief Wang Feng: "At the previous breach, chancellor's clerk Yang Yan said Yanshi used Yan's method to block it, but concealed this and refused to see him.
proposals.reason: The literal English is ungrammatical and obscures 蔽不肯見 (concealed [the method] and refused to meet him).

proposals.before: From Henan northward to Liyang, stone embankments forced the river eastward toward Pinggang in Dong Commandery;
proposals.after: From Henei northward to Liyang, stone embankments forced the river eastward toward Pinggang in Dong Commandery;
proposals.reason: Chinese 河內 denotes Henei commandery, not Henan.

proposals.before: From Henan north to Liyang, stone dikes forced the river east to strike Pinggang in Dong Commandery;
proposals.after: From Henei north to Liyang, stone dikes forced the river east to strike Pinggang in Dong Commandery;
proposals.reason: Chinese 河內 denotes Henei commandery, not Henan.

proposals.before: One should each follow water's nature and no longer irrigate; then all rivers flow freely, channels benefit themselves, and there will be no overflow-breach harm."
proposals.after: Each should be allowed to follow its nature, and irrigation should cease; then all rivers will flow freely, channels will benefit themselves, and there will be no overflow-breach harm."
proposals.reason: Literal English is ungrammatical: "One should each follow" does not match 可各順從其性; repair restores distributive "each" with natural English.

proposals.before: Chief clerk Wang Heng objected: "The river empties into Bohai, but Bohai terrain is actually higher than Han Mu's proposed cuts.
proposals.after: Chief Clerk of the Grand Minister of Works Wang Heng said: "The river empties into Bohai, but Bohai terrain is actually higher than Han Mu's proposed cuts.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits 大司空 from 大司空掾 and turns 言 into "objected"; restore the office title and neutral "said".

decisions.reason: The Chinese has 河內, the region/commandery name Henei, not 河南 (Henan); the proposed literal correctly restores that placename.
In 令齊人水工徐伯表, 表 is the hydraulic verb to survey and stake the canal line, not to present a memorial; the replacement matches that sense and keeps the rest of the sentence intact.

decisions.after: Du Qin advised Grand General Wang Feng: "During the previous breach, Chancellor's Clerk Yang Yan said that Yanshi had used a technique learned from him to close it, but Yanshi suppressed his claim and refused to see him.
decisions.reason: 蔽不肯見 means Yanshi suppressed Yang Yan's claim and refused to receive him. The original is ungrammatical, while the draft repair leaves the subject of both verbs unclear; the revision restores the names and agency explicitly.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 延世受焉術以塞之，蔽不肯見

decisions.reason: 河從河內北至黎陽 names Henei, not Henan; the idiomatic repair corrects that placename error.
The same 河內 in s0209 is Henei; the literal line must not read Henan, and the proposed replacement is exact.
可各順從其性 needs a distributive "each" subject; "One should each follow" is ungrammatical, and the proposed literal restores that sense plus 毋復灌溉 without adding extraneous meaning.

decisions.after: Clerk to the Grand Minister of Works Wang Heng said: "The river empties into Bohai, but Bohai terrain is actually higher than Han Mu's proposed cuts.
decisions.reason: 大司空掾 is a clerk attached to the Grand Minister of Works, not a chief clerk, and 言 is neutral "said." The revision restores the full office without promoting Wang Heng beyond the Chinese.
